reviews.title: Reviews
reviews.subtitle: What customers say about your products. Hide a review to remove it from the store without deleting it, and pick up to {{max}} to show on the home page.
reviews.pageHelp: Only customers who actually bought the product can review it, so these are all verified. Hide abuse or a factual mistake — not a low rating: honest 2-star reviews are what make the 5-star ones believable. Answer the customer instead.
reviews.slotsTitle: Reviews currently shown on the home page.
reviews.slotsFullTitle: All {{max}} home page slots are taken — unpick one to choose another.
reviews.pickAdd: Show this review on the home page
reviews.pickRemove: On the home page — click to remove
reviews.pickSlotsFull: All {{max}} slots are taken — unpick one first
reviews.pickHiddenBlocked: A hidden review cannot be shown on the home page
reviews.addedBody: Shoppers will see this review on the home page.
reviews.removedBody: This review no longer appears on the home page.
reviews.featureFailedTitle: Could not update the home page
reviews.confirmHide: Hide this review of "{{name}}" from the store? The customer keeps their review, but other shoppers won't see it.
reviews.hiddenBody: Shoppers will no longer see this review.
reviews.visibleBody: This review is shown in the store again.
reviews.confirmDelete: Permanently delete this review of "{{name}}"? This cannot be undone — hiding is usually enough.
